title: Spaghetti with Tomato Sauce
steps: Cut the tomatoes and the onion into small pieces.
Boil some water - add salt to it once it boils.
Put the spaghetti into the boiling water - they should be done in about 10 to 12 minutes.
In the meantime, heaten up some olive oil and add the cut onion.
After 2 minutes, add the tomato pieces, salt, pepper and your other spices.
The sauce will be done once the spaghetti are.
Feel free to add some cheese on top of the finished dish.

title: Toast Hawaii
steps: Butter one side of the white bread
Layer ham, the pineapple and cheese on the white bread
Bake the toast for round about 10 minutes in the oven at 200°C

title: Classic Hamburger
steps: Form 2 patties
Fry the patties for c. 4 minutes on each side
Quickly fry the buns for c. 1 minute on each side
Bruch buns with ketchup
Serve burger with tomato, cucumber and onion

title: Wiener Schnitzel
steps: Tenderize the veal to about 2–4mm, and salt on both sides.
On a flat plate, stir the eggs briefly with a fork.
Lightly coat the cutlets in flour then dip into the egg, and finally, coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat the butter and oil in a large pan (allow the fat to get very hot) and fry the schnitzels until golden brown on both sides.
Make sure to toss the pan regularly so that the schnitzels are surrounded by oil and the crumbing becomes ‘fluffy’.
Remove, and drain on kitchen paper. Fry the parsley in the remaining oil and drain.
Place the schnitzels on awarmed plate and serve garnishedwith parsley and slices of lemon.

title: Salad with Smoked Salmon
steps: Wash and cut salad and herbs
Dice the salmon
Process mustard, vinegar and olive oil into a dessing
Prepare the salad
Add salmon cubes and dressing

title: Delicious Orange Mousse
steps: Dissolve gelatine in pot
Add orange juice and sugar
Take pot off the stove
Add 2 tablespoons of yoghurt
Stir gelatin under remaining yoghurt
Cool everything down in the refrigerator
Whip the cream and lift it under die orange mass
Cool down again for at least 4 hours
Serve with orange peel

title: Pancakes
steps: In a large bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Make a well in the center and pour in the milk, egg and melted butter; mix until smooth.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium high heat.
Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake. Brown on both sides and serve hot.

title: Creamy Indian Chicken Curry
steps: Slice and fry the chicken breast
Process onion, garlic and ginger into paste and sauté everything
Add spices and stir fry
Add chicken breast + 250ml of water and cook everything for 10 minutes
Add coconut milk
Serve with rice

title: Chocolate Souffle
ingredients: 2 Ounces 70% dark Chocolate, broken into pieces
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Brush bottom and sides of 2 ramekins lightly with 1 teaspoon melted butter; cover bottom and sides right up to the rim.
Add 1 tablespoon white sugar to ramekins. Rotate ramekins until sugar coats all surfaces.
Place chocolate pieces in a metal mixing bowl.
Place bowl over a pan of about 3 cups hot water over low heat.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle in flour. Whisk until flour is incorporated into butter and mixture thickens.
Whisk in cold milk until mixture becomes smooth and thickens. Transfer mixture to bowl with melted chocolate.
Add salt and cayenne pepper. Mix together thoroughly. Add egg yolk and mix to combine.
Leave bowl above the hot (not simmering) water to keep chocolate warm while you whip the egg whites.
Place 2 egg whites in a mixing bowl; add cream of tartar. Whisk until mixture begins to thicken and a drizzle from the whisk stays on the surface about 1 second before disappearing into the mix.
Add 1/3 of sugar and whisk in. Whisk in a bit more sugar about 15 seconds.
whisk in the rest of the sugar. Continue whisking until mixture is about as thick as shaving cream and holds soft peaks, 3 to 5 minutes.
Transfer a little less than half of egg whites to chocolate.
Mix until egg whites are thoroughly incorporated into the chocolate.
Add the rest of the egg whites; gently fold into the chocolate with a spatula, lifting from the bottom and folding over.
Stop mixing after the egg white disappears. Divide mixture between 2 prepared ramekins. Place ramekins on prepared baking sheet.
Bake in preheated oven until scuffles are puffed and have risen above the top of the rims, 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Asparagus Salad with Cherry Tomatoes
steps: Wash, peel and cut the asparagus
Cook in salted water
Salt and pepper the asparagus
Roast the pine nuts
Halve the tomatoes
Mix with asparagus, salad and dressing
Serve with Baguette

title: Olive Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat the oven to 230 C.
Spread tomato sauce over the dough, leaving a small border.
Add torn mozzarella and sliced olives.
Bake until the crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbling.
Finish with basil, olive oil, salt, and pepper.

title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Cook the chopped onion in olive oil until soft.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned.
Stir in the rice and toast it for 1 minute.
Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring often.
Finish with butter and parmesan when the rice is creamy.

title: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer them on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Turkey Burger
steps: Season the turkey with salt and pepper and form 2 patties.
Cook the patties in a hot pan until done through.
Toast the buns for 1 minute.
Layer lettuce, tomato, onion, turkey, and mustard.
Serve while the burger is warm.

title: Black Bean Burger
steps: Mash the beans with chopped onion, garlic, oats, and paprika.
Shape the mixture into 2 firm patties.
Cook the patties in a lightly oiled pan until crisp.
Toast the buns and add lettuce and salsa.
Build the burgers and serve.

title: German Fried Potatoes with Egg
steps: Slice the cooked potatoes into thick rounds.
Fry onion and ham in oil until lightly browned.
Add the potatoes and cook until crisp at the edges.
Fry the eggs in a separate pan.
Serve potatoes with eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper.

title: Creamy Potato Soup
steps: Peel and cube the potatoes and carrot.
Cook the leek in a pot until soft.
Add potatoes, carrot, and stock and simmer until tender.
Blend the soup until smooth.
Stir in cream and season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Add berries, banana slices, and granola.
Drizzle with honey.
Finish with a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cook the eggs to your liking.
Spread avocado on the toast and add eggs.
Sprinkle with chili flakes.

title: Spinach Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Soften spinach and spring onion in a lightly oiled pan.
Pour in the eggs and cook over medium heat.
Add feta before folding the omelette.
Serve warm.

title: Salmon Rice Bowl
steps: Mix tamari and honey for a quick glaze.
Cook the salmon in a pan and brush it with the glaze.
Add cooked rice to bowls.
Top with cucumber, spinach, salmon, and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately.

title: Tofu Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu.
Stir fry tofu until golden, then remove it from the pan.
Cook the vegetables over high heat for a few minutes.
Return tofu to the pan and add tamari and sesame oil.
Serve with cooked rice.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Dice and cook the chicken until golden.
Push chicken aside and scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add rice, peas, spring onion, and soy sauce.
Stir fry until everything is hot.
Serve right away.

title: Ratatouille
steps: Dice all vegetables into similar-sized pieces.
Cook onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomatoes.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Season with herbs, salt, and pepper.

title: French Onion Soup
steps: Slice onions thinly.
Cook them slowly in butter until deeply golden.
Add stock and thyme and simmer for 25 minutes.
Top with toasted bread and grated cheese.
Broil until the cheese melts.

title: Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil the eggs and potatoes until cooked.
Blanch green beans until just tender.
Arrange vegetables, eggs, olives, and tuna on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Moroccan Bean Tagine
steps: Cook onion and carrot until soft.
Add tomatoes, beans, apricots, cumin, and cinnamon.
Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Finish with cilantro and serve with couscous or rice.

title: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
steps: Season shrimp with chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Cook shrimp quickly in a hot pan.
Mix cabbage with lime juice, yogurt, and cilantro.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill tortillas with slaw and shrimp.

title: Watermelon Feta Salad
steps: Cube the watermelon and cucumber.
Crumble feta over the fruit.
Add chopped mint.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.
Finish with black pepper.

title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend banana, berries, milk, and yogurt until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola and chia seeds.
Serve immediately while cold.
